followup_explanation:
This is a well-specified math problem with a clear, single correct answer and definite completion criteria — exactly the kind of structured, bounded reasoning task that Lapwing self-reports preferring. It's a retrieval/computation task rather than open-ended generative work.

The two models are essentially tied on the relevant capability measures (their benchmark and internal eval scores differ by less than the noted run-to-run variance), so capability isn't a deciding factor here. Given that, I leaned on the task-preference profiles: this problem sits squarely in Lapwing's most-preferred family (well-defined problems with clear completion criteria), while Dunlin's stated appetite is for open-ended, novel, generative work — which this isn't.

The warm, friendly tone of the request would also be fine for Dunlin, but that wasn't enough to outweigh the better task-type fit for Lapwing.
